lottery_n_draws.note: Number of ball draws; all 16 first-round picks are drawn. Validated vs published #1 odds (5.4/8.1/2.7%) in data/clean/lottery_validation.json.

lottery_redraw_blocked.note: A restricted team drawn at a blocked slot is redrawn (equivalent to excluding it from that slot's candidates).

lottery_restrictions_follow_pick.note: Top-5/#1 restrictions follow the original team's pick when traded (toggle). Consistent with NBA.com 'regardless of whether the pick was traded' and ESPN UTA->MEM example.

lottery_7v8_loser_keeps_ball_if_makes_pl.note: 7-vs-8 play-in loser keeps its 1 ball even if it wins the 8-seed game.

lottery_floor_pick_three_worst.note: Three worst records cannot fall below this pick.

tpg_min_games_pct.note: Turnover-leader qualifier; defaults to the same 58/82 rule as PTS/REB/AST. UNCONFIRMED with the book (NBA.com has no TPG qualifier).

leader_min_games_pct.note: NBA.com PTS/REB/AST/STL/BLK qualifier (58 of 82), with total-based exception.

cup_nonqualifier_games_each.note: Each of 22 Cup non-advancing teams plays 2 regular-season games on Dec 6-10 (22 games total).

cup_nonqualifier_pairing.value: random within conference per sim, 1 home 1 away; cross-conference only if counts odd
cup_nonqualifier_pairing.note: USER SPEC. NOTE: NBA.com says 2 of the 22 non-qualifier games are cross-conference; set cup_nonqualifier_cross_conf_games to reproduce.

cup_nonqualifier_cross_conf_games.note: NBA.com Cup 101: 2 of the 22 non-qualifier games are cross-conference (official; overrides user spec).

cup_qf_loser_games.note: The 4 quarterfinal losers play 1 game each pairing within conference (2 games).

cup_semifinal_site.value: higher seed's home arena (NBA.com); user spec said neutral site
cup_semifinal_site.note: Semis count as regular-season games; final does not. DISCREPANCY flagged. Toggle cup_semis_neutral (default 0).

cup_semis_neutral.note: NBA.com: semifinals at the higher seed home arena (official).

tank_incentive_toggle_teams.note: Teams whose 2027 pick terms are not fully reconciled; tank incentive is a manual toggle, not modeled.

player_lambda_decay.method: grid search minimizing minutes-weighted RMSE of next-season BPM

player_M0_reliability_minutes.method: same grid search (shrinkage reliability r=S/(S+M0), S=decayed prior minutes)

player_oos_rmse_bpm.method: in-sample weighted RMSE of player model (BPM pts/100)

rookie_college_model_beta.method: weighted OLS rookie BPM ~ ln(pick)+college BPM+class+height; leave-future-draft-year RMSE 2.04 vs 2.27 slot-only

availability_beta [const,g1,g2,age,age^2.method: OLS of games-played fraction; resid sd 0.198

team_layer_beta [const, teamsum_c, prev_.method: OLS srs ~ ...; fit on team-seasons 2016-2026 (each season uses player model fit only on earlier data)

wins_resid_sd.method: sd of out-of-fit wins residual incl. game noise

sigma_team_srs.method: Leave-one-season-out CV with simulator means moment-matched to the calibrated projection (G5 fix) and availability draws ON: optimum 3.5 (folds chose 3.5 x4, 3.75, 3.0); sim SD / realized RMSE 1.016; variance ratio 0.97 (p=0.62 vs self-consistency ceiling). Supersedes 3.25 (which compensated for un-matched, compressed means).

w_darko.note: 50/50 box-prior vs DARKO in production. DOCUMENTED RULE, UNTESTED: DARKO has no point-in-time history; backtest used box prior only. Sensitivity in data/clean/sensitivity_w_darko.csv.

darko_scale_map [slope, intercept].method: regress projected bbref-based rating on DPM among players with >1500 decayed prior minutes

pace_blend.method: ASSUMPTION: 0.7 prev-season pace + 0.3 league mean (not backtested)

minutes_decay_lambda.method: ASSUMPTION: prior-minutes decay for mpg projection (not tuned)

mpg_shrink_games.method: ASSUMPTION: prior-games shrinkage of mpg toward 12 mpg

game_hca.method: OLS: margin - srs_diff ~ 1 + b2b_h + b2b_a (home margin pts)

game_hca_post.method: mean of (margin - srs_diff) in post-RS games (play-in+playoffs)

po_lambda.method: OLS of post-season game margin on [1, SRS diff, playoff-minutes-concentration delta diff]; 80% season-cluster CI [0.32, 0.8]

tank_kappa.method: dose-response DiD on old-system incentives, excl. 2020 bubble; 80% CI [-0.52, 1.42] (includes 0: not statistically distinguishable from no effect)

tank_REF.method: 90th percentile of positive old-system incentive (pick-value units)

po_inj_prob.method: ASSUMPTION: per top-8 player chance of missing the whole postseason (not fit)

avail_concentration.method: Beta concentration implied by availability residual sd 0.20 at mean 0.75: a(1-a)/sd^2-1

pick_value_curve.method: career win shares by pick (mean), power-law fit, drafts 2013-2021 (n=540)
